product-description-content: Protègenet is an aluminum window sill system. It protects window sills and facades. It can be used in new construction as well as renovation. The system consists of a window sill with rounded edge and finishing tips.
product-description-extra:
CAUTION:
Manufacturing depth: Allow concrete dimension + 30 mm.
Manufacturing length: Allow - 10 mm for the passage of the tips.
quantite-emb: Pairs (1x left + 1x right) of end caps
warning-painting-anodised: Anodized finish is not recommended (whitening of the sheet metal at the folded edges).
